label: Illustrative example: a site engineer's diary entry for one day on a building site, submitted and waiting for the project manager to sign it off.
title: Friday 16 October 2026
subtitle: Written by Segun Oladipo, site engineer · submitted 17:42 · rain 07:00 to 10:00, then dry, 29°C

items.title: Work done
items.body: Floor 5 slab: formwork finished, 60% of the reinforcement fixed. Floor 4 block walls: grids A to C complete. Roof trusses delivered and counted, 14 of 14.

items.title: Delays and problems
items.body: No concrete until 10:30 because of the rain. Cement arrived 2 hours late and the supplier was told. An electrical conduit clashes at grid D on floor 4, waiting for the engineer's answer.

items.title: Instructions and visitors
items.body: Architect's instruction AI-0018: move the floor 5 door openings 150 mm. The client's surveyor visited from 11:00 to 12:30.
